name: KITN Rhythm
memo: Rage Against the Machine - Killing in the Name: rhythm. Tom Morello: JCM800 2205 boost channel, tight mid-forward grit, no effects.

band.style_feel: heavy half-time-ish groove, tight kick locked to the riff, open snare/crash on the big chorus hits
band.key: D minor (D Phrygian flavour; analyzers disagree)
parts: Part A: intro riff - sparse, drums and bass lock in
Part B: verse - same riff, restrained groove
Part C: chorus 'Killing in the name of' - full band
Part D: bridge/build 'Some of those that work forces' - rising intensity
Part E: final 'Fuck you I won't do what you tell me' outburst and outro - full on
band.tips: Tempo is about 88-89 BPM (sources vary). Play the main riff cleanly for 2 bars before starting the Trio+ learn pass; keep it tight and steady, since the song is built on repetition.

name: KITN Wah Solo
memo: Killing in the Name: solo. Morello's wah/Whammy-style squeal; wah on the fx slot, boosted lead level, short delay.
